# Test fixtures from Apache POI

`legacy-basic.ppt` and `legacy-textbox.ppt` are `basic_test_ppt_file.ppt` and `with_textbox.ppt` from the Apache POI test data
(https://github.com/apache/poi/tree/trunk/test-data/slideshow), unchanged except for the file name.

Apache POI. Copyright 2003-2026 The Apache Software Foundation. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). These files are used by the tests only and are not shipped in the extension.

`legacy-broken.ppt` is the first 600 bytes of `legacy-basic.ppt`. `renamed-pptx.ppt` is `quarterly-review.pptx` under another name.
